73997-a-history-of-socialism.creator: Thomas Kirkup
73997-a-history-of-socialism.description: A book by Thomas Kirkup. From his youth Saint-Simon felt the promptings of an eager ambition. His valet had orders to awake him every morning with the words, ‘Remember, monsieur le comte, that you have great things to do’; and his ancestor Charlemagne appeared to him in a dream, foretelling a remarkable future for him.

arxiv-2003-12458.title: Practical Quantum Computing: solving the wave equation using a quantum approach
arxiv-2003-12458.creator: Adrien Suau, Gabriel Staffelbach, Henri Calandra
arxiv-2003-12458.description: Abstract In the last years, several quantum algorithms that try to address the problem of partial differential equation solving have been devised. On one side, “direct” quantum algorithms that aim at encoding the solution of the PDE by executing one large quantum circuit.

arxiv-2203-12539.title: Holographic model for light quarks in anisotropic hot dense QGP with external magnetic field.
arxiv-2203-12539.creator: Irina Ya. Aref’eva a , Alexey Ermakov a , Kristina Rannu a and Pavel Slepov a
arxiv-2203-12539.description: Abstract We present a five-dimensional twice anisotropic holographic model supported by Einstein-dilaton-three-Maxwell action describing light quarks. The first of the Maxwell fields provides finite chemical potential. The second Maxwell field serves for anisotropy, characterizing spatial anisotropy of the QGP produced in heavy-ion collisions (HIC). The third Maxwell field is related to a magnetic field that appears in HIC.

arxiv-2210-01144.title: An environmental analysis of the fast transient AT2018cow and implications for its progenitor and late-time brightness 2023 An environmental analysis of the fast transient AT2018cow and implications for its progenitor and late-time brightness – References
arxiv-2210-01144.creator: Ning-Chen Sun, Justyn R. Maund, Yali Shao, Ida A. Janiak1 School of Astronomy and Space Science, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, 19A Yuquan Road, Shijingshan District, Beijing 100049, China2 National Astronomical Observatories, Chinese Academy of Sciences, 20A Datun Road, Chaoyang Distric
arxiv-2210-01144.description: Abstract The nature of the newly discovered fast blue optical transients (FBOTs) is still puzzling astronomers. In this paper we carry out a comprehensive analysis of the molecular gas, ionized gas and stellar populations in the environment of the nearby FBOT AT2018cow based on ALMA, VLT/MUSE and HST/WFC3 observations.

arxiv-2210-09078.title: Machine Learning Technique Predicting Video Streaming Views to Reduce Cost of Cloud Services
arxiv-2210-09078.creator: Mahmoud Darwich, Mahmoud Darwich
arxiv-2210-09078.description: Abstract Video streams tremendously occupied the highest portion of the online traffic. Multiple versions of a video are created to fit the user’s device specifications. In cloud storage, Keeping all versions of frequently accessed video streams in the repository for the long term imposes a significant cost paid by video streaming providers.

arxiv-2304-00798.title: Topology of the space of conormal distributions Thanks: The authors are partially supported by the grants MTM2017-89686-P and PID2020-114474GB-I00 (AEI/FEDER, UE) and ED431C 2019/10 (Xunta de Galicia, FEDER)
arxiv-2304-00798.creator: Jesús A. Álvarez López, Yuri A. Kordyukov, Eric Leichtnam
arxiv-2304-00798.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jesús A. Álvarez López, Yuri A. Kordyukov, Eric Leichtnam. Given a closed manifold M M and a closed regular submanifold L L , consider the corresponding locally convex space I = I ⁡ ( M , L ) I=I(M,L) of conormal distributions, with its natural topology, and the strong dual I ′ = I ′ ​ ( M , L ) = I ​ ( M , L , Ω ) ′ I^{\prime}=I^{\prime}(M,L)=I(M,L;\Omega)^{\prime} of the space of conormal densities.

arxiv-2307-05145.title: Global smooth solution for the 3D generalized tropical climate model with partial viscosity and damping Thanks: The authors are supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China (No. 12271293, No. 11901342 and No. 11701269), Natural Science Foundation of Shandong Province (No. ZR2023MA00
arxiv-2307-05145.creator: Hui Liu Chengfeng Sun Mei Li 1 1 . School of Mathematical Sciences, Qufu Normal University, Qufu, Shandong 273165, PR China; 2 2 . School of Applied Mathematics, Nanjing University of Finance and Economics, Nanjing, 210023, PR China
arxiv-2307-05145.description: Abstract Abstract The three-dimensional generalized tropical climate model with partial viscosity and damping is considered in this paper. Global well-posedness of solutions of the three-dimensional generalized tropical climate model with partial viscosity and damping is proved for \alpha\geq\frac{3}{2} and \beta\geq 4 .

arxiv-2307-15805.title: Equilibria and incentives for illiquid auction markets École Polytechnique, CMAP; mathieu.rosenbaum@polytechnique.edu This work benefits from the financial support of the Chaires Analytics and Models for Regulation, Deep finance and statistics, Machine learning and systematic methods.
arxiv-2307-15805.creator: Joffrey Derchu, Dimitrios Kavvathas, Thibaut Mastrolia
arxiv-2307-15805.description: Abstract We study a toy two-player game for periodic double auction markets to generate liquidity. The game has imperfect information, which allows us to link market spreads with signal strength. We characterize Nash equilibria in cases with or without incentives from the exchange. This enables us to derive new insights about price formation and incentives design.

arxiv-2309-00045.title: The energy distribution of the first supernovae 2023 The energy distribution of the first supernovae – 13
arxiv-2309-00045.creator: I. Koutsouridou, S. Salvadori, Á. Skúladóttir, M. Rossi, I. Vanni, G. Pagnini
arxiv-2309-00045.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by I. Koutsouridou, S. Salvadori, Á. Skúladóttir, M. Rossi, I. Vanni, G. Pagnini. The nature of the first Pop III stars is still a mystery and the energy distribution of the first supernovae is completely unexplored. For the first time we account simultaneously for the unknown initial mass function (IMF), stellar mixing, and energy distribution function (EDF) of Pop III stars in the context of a cosmological model for the formation of a MW-analogue.

arxiv-2312-05129.title: Evidence for vertical line nodes in Sr 2 RuO 4 from nonlocal electrodynamics
arxiv-2312-05129.creator: J. F. Landaeta, K. Semeniuk, J. Aretz, K. Shirer, D. A. Sokolov, N. Kikugawa, Y. Maeno, I. Bonalde, J. Schmalian, A. P. Mackenzie, E. Hassinger
arxiv-2312-05129.description: Abstract By determining the superconducting lower and upper critical fields H c1 ​ ( T ) H_{\mathrm{c1}}(T) and H c2 ​ ( T ) H_{\mathrm{c2}}(T) , respectively, in a high-purity spherical Sr 2 RuO 4 sample via ac-susceptibility measurements, we obtain the temperature dependence of the coherence length ξ \xi and the penetration depth λ \lambda down to 0.

arxiv-2411-18167.title: Quantum annealing of a frustrated magnet
arxiv-2411-18167.creator: Yuqian Zhao, Zhaohua Ma, Zhangzhen He, Haijun Liao, Yan-Cheng Wang, Junfeng Wang, Yuesheng Li
arxiv-2411-18167.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yuqian Zhao, Zhaohua Ma, Zhangzhen He, Haijun Liao, Yan-Cheng Wang, Junfeng Wang, Yuesheng Li. 2023 Quantum annealing, which involves quantum tunnelling among possible solutions, has state-of-the-art applications not only in quickly finding the lowest-energy configuration of a complex system, but also in quantum computing. Here we report a single-crystal study of the frustrated magnet \alpha -CoV 2 O 6 , consisting of a triangular arrangement of ferromagnetic Ising spin chains without evident structural disorder.

arxiv-2510-00351.title: Flow Autoencoders are Effective Protein Tokenizers
arxiv-2510-00351.creator: Rohit Dilip, Evan Zhang, Ayush Varshney, David Van Valen
arxiv-2510-00351.description: Abstract Protein structure tokenizers enable the creation of multimodal models of protein structure, sequence, and function. Current approaches to protein structure tokenization rely on bespoke components that are invariant to spatial symmetries, but that are challenging to optimize and scale. We present Kanzi, a flow-based tokenizer for tokenization and generation of protein structures.

arxiv-2510-13786.title: The Art of Scaling Reinforcement Learning Compute for LLMs
arxiv-2510-13786.creator: Devvrit Khatri, Lovish Madaan, Rishabh Tiwari, Rachit Bansal, Sai Surya Duvvuri, Manzil Zaheer, Inderjit S. Dhillon, David Brandfonbrener, Rishabh Agarwal
arxiv-2510-13786.description: Abstract Reinforcement learning (RL) has become central to training large language models (LLMs), yet the field lacks predictive scaling methodologies comparable to those established for pre-training. Despite rapidly rising compute budgets, there is no principled understanding of how to evaluate algorithmic improvements for scaling RL compute.

pmc-10539509.title: Inequity in mortality rates and potential years of life lost caused by COVID-19 in the Greater Santiago, Chile
pmc-10539509.creator: Andrés Ayala, Claudio Vargas, Felipe Elorrieta, Pablo Villalobos Dintrans, Matilde Maddaleno
pmc-10539509.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Several studies have shown that, in Chile, income inequality is relevant in explaining health inequities. The COVID-19 pandemic has also had a negative impact, with higher mortality rates in those municipalities of Greater Santiago with lower socioeconomic status. We study inequity in mortality based on Potential Years of Life Lost (PYLL) in 34 urban municipalities of the Metropolitan Region (Greater Santiago) and analyze its evolution between 2018 and 2021 and by COVID-19 waves.

pmc-10589836.title: Identification and Prediction of Clinical Phenotypes in Hospitalized Patients With COVID-19: Machine Learning From Medical Records
pmc-10589836.creator: Tom Velez, Tony Wang, Brian Garibaldi, Eric Singman, Ioannis Koutroulis, Amaryllis Mavragani, Jiaqian Luo, LaVar Edwards, Zidu Xu
pmc-10589836.description: BackgroundThere is significant heterogeneity in disease progression among hospitalized patients with COVID-19. The pathogenesis of SARS-CoV-2 infection is attributed to a complex interplay between virus and host immune response that in some patients unpredictably and rapidly leads to “hyperinflammation” associated with increased risk of mortality.

pmc-11497510.title: Increased Deltoid and Acromial Stress with Glenoid Lateralization and Onlay Humeral Stem Constructs in Reverse Shoulder Arthroplasty
pmc-11497510.creator: Brendan M Patterson, Joshua E Johnson, Maria Bozoghlian, Donald D Anderson
pmc-11497510.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundReverse shoulder arthroplasty (RSA) designs include multiple options for glenoid component lateralization, and humeral component lateralization and distalization (inlay/onlay constructs). The influence of combined glenoid lateralization, and humeral distalization on acromial and deltoid stresses is not well understood. The purpose of this study was to evaluate changes in deltoid and acromial stresses with variations in glenoid lateralization, and with inlay versus onlay humeral components in RSA.MethodsFinite element analysis was performed using a RSA system with both inlay and onlay configurations.

pmc-12518887.title: Feasibility, Acceptability, and Preliminary Outcomes of a Mobile Adaptation of a Relational Savoring Intervention to Prevent Loneliness in College Students: Mixed Methods Pilot Study
pmc-12518887.creator: Brenda Nguyen, Jocelyn Lai, Hana Qureshi, Christopher Marcotullio, Sina Labbaf, Yuning Wang, Salar Jafarlou, Nikil Dutt, Amir M Rahmani, Jessica L Borelli, Amaryllis Mavragani
pmc-12518887.description: BackgroundRates of loneliness have risen sharply since the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic, largely due to disruptions in social relationships and daily routines, with college students experiencing some of the greatest increases. While prevention programs targeting loneliness have been developed, their success has been limited.

pmc-12626160.title: Time-Dependent Mortality Predictors in Primary Sjögren’s Syndrome: C-Reactive Protein for Early Risk and Age for Late Outcomes
pmc-12626160.creator: Jia-Qi Chen, Yan Zhang, Zi-Wei Huang, Jian-Ying Yang, Jia-He Liao, Chun-Xin Lei, Xi-Ya Zhang, Xin-Bo Yu, Tzu-Hua Wu, Zi-Han Liu, Bo-Jie Tang, Xuan-Yi Zhou, Tian-Tian Deng, Jing Luo, Wei-Jiang Song, Qing-Wen Tao
pmc-12626160.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). PurposeTo identify risk factors for near-term and long-term death in patients with primary Sjogren’s syndrome (pSS).Patients and MethodsThis ambispective cohort study included all patients with pSS treated at China–Japan Friendship Hospital between 2013 and 2023. The time-dependent Cox regression analysis was used for statistical analysis of risk factors, with 3 months and 60 months as the cut-off time points and all-cause death as the primary endpoint.ResultsAmong the 1252 included patients, 138 patients had died by the end of follow-up (11.0%).

pmc-12934342.title: Cardiometabolic index (CMI) and sarcopenia as predictors of all-cause and cardiovascular mortality in chronic kidney disease: a NHANES-based cohort study
pmc-12934342.creator: Zixuan Zhang, Yue Xing, Fan Zhang, Xianwen Zhang, Yifei Zhong
pmc-12934342.description: The Cardiometabolic Index (CMI) reflects visceral adiposity and lipid dysregulation, while sarcopenia indicates skeletal muscle depletion, both representing metabolic and functional decline in chronic kidney disease (CKD). This study aimed to investigate the impact of CMI and sarcopenia, as well as their integration into a metabolico-muscular composite risk model, on all-cause and cardiovascular mortality in CKD patients.
